title: pneumonanthe rusbyi
intro: Pneumonanthe rusbyi, commonly known as Rusby's Lungwort, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Pneumonanthe rusbyi include expectorant and antitussive properties, helping to relieve congestion and calm the cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenes, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
